interpretation: R1 headline of LS=0.63 was single-best-phase out of 21; honest mean-across-phases is 0.24. Mechanism is real (phase-averaged Sharpe is positive at all 3 selection modes) but signal-to-noise is much lower than R1 implied. Worst-year never recovers above -0.11 across any phase.

F7_residualized_vs_F1.interpretation: After stripping 252d momentum, ~48% of F1's signal remains; the factor is partially but not entirely a momentum clone. Still meaningful residual but worst-year deteriorates further.

decision_recommendation: Continue RESEARCH-ONLY. Reject the previously-implied 'lead candidate' framing of E3@phase0. The honest production candidate is the phase-averaged top-5 long-only ensemble with Sharpe 0.12 net — too weak to PROMOTE in isolation but a viable component for a multi-factor sleeve.
